segments.he: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב: זוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר, אֲבָל חֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֵין חֲלִיצַת קָטָן כְּלוּם.
segments.en: «Rav Yehuda said» that «Rav said: This» teaching of the mishna with regard to a minor is «the statement of Rabbi Meir,» who maintains that such a ḥalitza has significance in that it disqualifies a subsequent levirate marriage, but it is insufficient to permit the woman to marry a stranger. «But the Rabbis say: The ḥalitza of a male minor isn’t» significant of «anything,» as she is permitted to one of the brothers in levirate marriage as one who performed no ḥalitza at all.
